note: 20 HARD proactive transcripts. Each is 60 to 200 words of natural speech with filler, tangents, partial thoughts. Tests the engine's ability to pick up buried intent, resolve memory references, take initiative, and ignore chatter. Dossier names used are placeholders aligned with the repo's existing convention (Maya ops partner, Marcus finance) plus a richer cast. The downstream phase reconciles dossier IDs against the rich dossier at state/v7/test_dossier_rich.json.
difficulty_scale: 1 lightest (intent close to the surface) to 5 hardest (deeply buried, multi-hop memory resolution, must initiate without an imperative verb).
